segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing it as her holy grail and another using it postpartum, consistently report deep, lasting hydration, plumpness, and softer, smoother skin, with several saying it fits well into a minimal routine or even replaces a moisturizer in hot weather.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some who normally react to fragrance or new products, mostly report no irritation, reduced redness, and a calming effect; one reviewer without notably sensitive skin experienced a mild breakout and became reluctant to keep using it on her face.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one whose skin leans oily in summer and drier in winter and another with acne-prone combination skin, say it hydrates well, though the latter notices her skin gets slightly oily a few hours after application.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone, sensitivity-leaning skin says it locks in moisture and helps control sebum without feeling heavy or greasy.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers describe improved elasticity and firmness over time, with one in her late twenties using it as part of early anti-aging care for subtle plumpness.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across dry, sensitive, and combination skin, report noticeable, lasting hydration and plumpness, several using it as a stand-alone moisturizer in hot weather or layering it for extra dryness; a couple of reviewers found the hydration only modest, no more noticeable than other toners in the same price range.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones with sensitive skin, report the toner calms existing redness and irritation, with one saying it visibly reduced her redness within one use.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers say the toner strengthens or supports the skin barrier, reporting fewer dry patches and less redness with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts, and one says increased hydration has meant fewer breakouts overall; one reviewer experienced a mild breakout and stopped using it on her face while continuing on her neck and chest.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-skin reviewers mostly say it helps control sebum and doesn't leave a greasy feel; one with combination, acne-prone skin notices her skin turning slightly oily a few hours after application.

extraits.texte: This is a decent toner and makes my skin feel hydrated enough. It is mildly viscous, but light and absorbable, at least compared to TirTir. I personally prefer something "milkier," but if you want something heavier than water and find other toners too oily, slow to absorb, or dewy, then this will work for you.

This essence is a nice consistency, kind of milky and not at all sticky. I was excited to use this product, but unfortunately it did make me break out mildly so I've been reluctant to use again on my face. I don't have overly sensitive skin, so I am hoping to try this product again in a few weeks. I have been using on my neck and chest and it's very hydrating and rich without being heavy.

extraits.titre: Provides Long-lasting Hydration and Helps Keep Skin Smooth
extraits.texte: I was provided with a complimentary bottle of Ma:nyo's Panthetoin Essence Toner for testing and reviewing purposes. This toner is different from other toners I have previously used. Its consistency is thicker when first poured onto one's hands, but once it's applied to skin, it is quickly absorbed. The formula comes in a plastic, easy to pour bottle. Just pouring a little onto your fingertips is enough to apply onto your face, and you can opt to use one layer or apply a few layers for additional hydration. A little goes a long way, so one bottle will last a while. The formula itself is comprised of ingredients that help provide hydration and help skin retain moisture throughout the day. I personally have sensitive, dry skin and have to be mindful of the products I use so as not to damage or irritate my skin. I love this toner because it doesn't irritate my skin, it provides hydration, and helps keep my skin soft and smooth. I use this toner twice a day - once in the morning and then again before bed. On days I opt to skip doing a full skincare routine, I simply apply this product and I'm good to go. I had not previously tried this brand, but this product has become a staple in my daily skincare routine. I highly recommend it if your looking for a toner that will nurture your skin and provide lasting hydration.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the ma:nyo Panthetoin Essence Toner and it's become one of my favorite steps in my skincare routine. The texture is lightweight but slightly jelly-like, so it feels really refreshing going on. I love patting in 2–3 layers when my skin feels extra dry, and it never stings or irritates my sensitive skin. My skin always feels hydrated and calm after using it, and I've noticed my barrier feels stronger—less redness and fewer dry patches. It also gives a nice "glow from within" look that makes my skin look healthier even before moisturizer. The only small thing is that if I apply too many layers it can feel a little tacky, but once it fully absorbs it's fine. Honestly, I'll take that for the hydration it gives! If you're looking for a toner that's gentle, soothing, and actually makes a difference in hydration, this one is worth trying. Perfect for anyone with dry, sensitive, or stressed skin.
